extensionName.description: Name of the extension, shown in the browser's extension list.

extensionDescription.message: Dessine une frise chronologique imagée à partir des dates de l'article Wikipédia que vous lisez.
extensionDescription.description: Description of the extension, shown in the browser's extension list.

bannerTitle.description: Heading of the banner injected above a Wikipedia article.

bannerEmpty.message: Aucune date trouvée sur cette page.
bannerEmpty.description: Shown in the banner when no date was read from the page.

bannerCount.description: Shown in the banner: how many dates were read from the page.

timelineLabel.message: Frise : la molette ou deux doigts zooment, un glisser déplace ; flèches, + et - une fois sélectionnée.
timelineLabel.description: Accessible name of the timeline, which says how to move it.

zoomIn.description: Button that zooms the timeline in.

zoomOut.description: Button that zooms the timeline out.

zoomFit.description: Button that brings the timeline back to the window it opened on.

yearBc.description: A year before the common era, on the timeline's axis.

tickMonth.description: A month on the timeline's axis: its short name, then its year.

tickMyr.description: Millions of years ago, on the timeline's axis.

tickGyr.description: Billions of years ago, on the timeline's axis.

myTimelineTitle.description: Title of the reader's own timeline: its page, and the banner's button to it.

myTimelineOpen.description: Tooltip of the toolbar button and of the banner's button that open the reader's timeline.

addToMyTimeline.description: The + on a card of the banner's timeline, and the title of the form that adds an event.

addSelection.description: Button shown below text selected in an article: adds the date in it to the reader's timeline.

savedTo.description: Note shown once an event is added to the reader's timeline.

defaultLayerName.description: Name of the layer made when the reader adds a first event.

editEntry.description: Button that opens the form of an event of the reader's timeline; title of that form.

deleteEntry.description: Button of the form that deletes the event.

confirmDeleteEntry.message: Supprimer cet évènement de votre frise ?
confirmDeleteEntry.description: Asked before an event of the reader's timeline is deleted.

fieldDate.description: Label of the form's date field.

fieldDateHint.message: Comme une page l'écrirait : 14 juillet 1789, 1914-1918, 500 av. J.-C., il y a 66 millions d'années.
fieldDateHint.description: Hint below the form's date field.

dateRead.description: Status of the form's date field when the date written is read.

dateNotRead.message: Aucune date reconnue dans ce texte.
dateNotRead.description: Status of the form's date field when no date is read.

fieldTitle.description: Label of the form's title field.

fieldLink.description: Label of the form's field for the address the event leads to.

fieldDescription.description: Label of the form's description field.

fieldDescriptionHint.description: Hint below the description field: how to write a link.

fieldImage.description: Legend of the form's picture section.

fieldImageUrl.description: Label of the field for the URL of a picture.

choosePhoto.description: Button that picks a photo of the device (the camera, on a phone).

removeImage.description: Button that removes the event's picture.

photoFailed.message: Cette image n'a pas pu être lue.
photoFailed.description: Shown when a picked file is not a picture the browser reads.

fieldLayer.description: Label of the form's layer field.

newLayerOption.description: Last choice of the form's layer field: names a new layer.

newLayerName.description: Placeholder of the field naming a new layer.

fieldTags.description: Label of the form's tags field.

fieldTagsHint.message: Séparés par des virgules ; ou choisissez-en un ci-dessous.

cancel.description: Button that closes the form without saving.

addEntry.description: Button of the timeline page that opens a blank form.

exportButton.description: Button that saves the whole timeline, photos included, as a file.

exportDone.description: Status once the timeline is exported.

importButton.description: Button that merges a backup file into the timeline.

importDone.message: Importé : $COUNT$ éléments ajoutés ou mis à jour, rien d'effacé.
importDone.description: Status once a backup is merged.

importFailed.message: Ce fichier n'est pas une sauvegarde de frise.
importFailed.description: Status when the imported file is not a backup.

emptyTimeline.message: Votre frise est vide. Sur un article de Wikipédia, appuyez sur le + d'une vignette, ou sélectionnez une date dans le texte, pour l'ajouter ici.
emptyTimeline.description: Shown on the timeline page while there is no event.

layerVisible.description: Checkbox that shows or hides a layer.

layerName.description: Accessible name of a layer's name field.

confirmDeleteLayer.message: Supprimer le calque « $NAME$ » et ses $COUNT$ évènements ?
confirmDeleteLayer.description: Asked before a layer and its events are deleted.

addLayer.description: Button that makes a new layer.

noTags.description: Shown in the tag filter while no event has a tag.

allTags.description: Button that clears the tag filter.

entriesHeading.description: Heading of the list of the events shown.
